parameters.name: attachResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the attached resource.

parameters.name: attachResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource to which the policy can be attached. Valid values:
- HttpApi: HttpApi.
- Operation: an operation of an HttpApi.
- GatewayRoute: a gateway route.
- GatewayService: a gateway service.
- GatewayServicePort: a gateway service port.
- Domain: a gateway domain name.
- Gateway: a gateway.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the policy. Valid values:
- OutBound: outbound.
- InBound: inbound.
- Both: both directions.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.
